original.caveat: Rust interleaves validation; Java does not.

scope: Two sequential matched I/O-only runs on the same 100,000-object RDF/XML input, reversing implementation order. Diagnostic follow-up; does not replace the primary scaling matrix or establish a language-level ranking.
source_observation: Rust v1.0.0 Document::read builds an RDF graph, identity/property indexes, and owned typed objects. libSBOLj3 1.0.5.2 reads a Jena model and wraps it; SBOL object lists are populated on access. No profiler attribution of the timing gap was performed.
